reviews.name: ivy hughes
reviews.text: Love this place my partner and I go all the time for a great breakfast and absolutely amazing coffee!!! 🩷🩷

reviews.name: Charlie Kroger
reviews.text: Really great food and the owner is so friendly. My accommodation was close by so I went here everyday since the price and the quality of the food

reviews.name: Shepherd Sargent
reviews.text: Food is fresh and tasty at a great price. The family is kind and hospitable. We went here for 3 meals a day for the time We spent in canngu.

reviews.name: isaac dale
reviews.text: Amazing service, very good food for cheap, quality coffees and lattes. The owners are extremely kind and friendly. I recommend to all tourists

reviews.name: Nadja Ha
reviews.text: The food is always fresh and delicious! Never disappointed me. Also really cheap

reviews.name: Ash Wells
reviews.text: Great food, good price. Always have fat chats with the owner, very nice people. Great place to come for breakfast, lunch, dinner and BINTANG.

reviews.name: Olaf de Rooij
reviews.text: Lovely family, with great food, and love for making people happy with a proper conversations l, great food and a wonderful scooter rental service 🙏

reviews.name: Julien
reviews.text: The owner is fantastic: he can prepare custom dishes if you request it in advance. You can go there without hesitation, you won't be disappointed, and the prices are very reasonable. Thanks again!

reviews.name: Yannis Nouari
reviews.text: I stayed in Bali for a week and came to this restaurant every day because the price, the staff, and the food are excellent. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Maisie McCall
reviews.text: Cute little cafe with great fresh food, iced coffee was delicious. Owner was very kind, would definitely go back.

reviews.name: Яна Максимова
reviews.text: Very cheap and tasty, we didn't expect anything for that price, but everything was fresh, we ate our fill, breakfast was 45k, I definitely recommend having breakfast here

reviews.name: Aldienezha Devangga
reviews.text: Small but really cozy, has good wifi too. The food is unbelievably good. Gonna come here again soon.

reviews.name: Lisa Lauret
reviews.text: Very good food. We are eating here every night since one week! Thank you so much

reviews.name: Quirky Cocktails
reviews.text: The coffee is delicious, it is recommended for those who want to come here to order the hazelnut latte tropical sweet & salted caramel, it is a must try and there are several delicious mocktails menus that are worth trying

reviews.name: Elisa Khristina
reviews.text: The food and coffee are delicious. The prices are very pocket-friendly. The owner is also friendly.

reviews.name: Donny Saputra
reviews.text: Comfortable place, food and drinks are suitable for college students' pockets... street food prices, five-star taste 👍

reviews.name: Victor Madsen
reviews.text: Super cozy, delisious food. Come and try it out :)
